text:
maria_support: Heads-up — ACME Conversions reported a regression after today's hosted model push (rwd-llm-v9a). They say the assistant stopped asking clarifying questions and returns very concise steps that skip important context. Pasting their repro and examples they sent.

maria_support: Customer repro (copied):
```
User: I'm integrating your payments API and I get a 422 when creating a charge. Here's the flow: I create a customer, then attach a card token, then POST /charges. Error: 'invalid_amount'. How should I proceed?
```

maria_support: Their "Before" example (rwd-llm-v9):
```
Assistant: Sorry you're hitting that. Quick checks: 1) confirm amount is in cents and > 0; 2) validate currency code matches active account; 3) inspect previous responses for plan limits. If you can paste the request body (without secrets) I'll look for mismatches. Also, do you have any coupon or trial flag on the account?
```

maria_support: Their "After" example (rwd-llm-v9a):
```
Assistant: Check amount is positive and in cents, make sure currency matches. If error persists, send the request body.
```

sam_cse: Customer reports this is causing user confusion — they say end users don't know what to change. Marking P2 but customer wants faster turnaround.

alex_eng: Can you drop the raw request headers/resolved model tag and the exact curl they used? Also what sampling params did they set? Short replies often indicate a decoding bias change.

maria_support: Curl they used (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Model-Version: rwd-llm-v9a" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"I'm integrating your payments API and ..."}], "temperature":0.0, "max_tokens":300}'
```
Response headers from logs: `x-model-version: rwd-llm-v9a`, `x-request-id: req_01F...`, `x-latency-ms: 142`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete — rwd-llm-v9a -> hosted-prod @ 2026-03-17T08:03:12Z :rocket:

jordan_ml: Quick hypothesis: v9a introduced a small instruction-compression change to reduce verbosity (we added a conciseness prior during fine-tune). With temp=0.0 that can collapse clarifying probes. Could also be a decoding default tweak (beam/penalties).

alex_eng: I'll run an A/B on hosted with the customer's prompt pinned to rwd-llm-v9 and rwd-llm-v9a, using the same params (temp=0.0). If we see consistent truncation of probing sentences, we either revert the conciseness prior or expose a model-surface flag to preserve old behavior.

maria_support: Attaching the customer-request log block (redacted):
```
request_id: req_01F...
model: rwd-llm-v9a
temperature: 0.0
max_tokens: 300
user_agent: ACME-internal/1.2.0
latency_ms: 142
```

sam_cse: ACME says they're OK to test a canary pinned to rwd-llm-v9 for their org for a limited window if we can do it today. Their timezone: PST. What's the ETA?

alex_eng: I can get a pinned route live in ~3 hours. For immediate triage I'm going to run local decodes with top-k/top-p and our sampler traces. I'll capture top token logits and next-token probs to compare where the model stopped asking clarifying Qs.

jordan_ml: If traces show conciseness prior is the cause we should: 1) revert the prior for hosted-prod, 2) add an opt-in 'concise_generation' knob surfaced in the API, and 3) add a regression test that checks for presence of at least one clarifying question on our payments prompt suite.

maria_support: Reproducer script for eng (for quick run):
```
# run A vs B
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer ${KEY}" -H "X-Model-Version: rwd-llm-v9a" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"I'm integrating your payments API and I get a 422 when creating a charge..."}], "temperature":0.0, "max_tokens":300}' > after.json
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer ${KEY}" -H "X-Model-Version: rwd-llm-v9" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"I'm integrating your payments API and I get a 422 when creating a charge..."}], "temperature":0.0, "max_tokens":300}' > before.json
diff before.json after.json | sed -n '1,200p'
```

alex_eng: :thumbsup: Running now. Will post diffs and a short trace (top-5 tokens and probs) when done. If we can confirm, I'll wire a quick revert or add the per-tenant preservation flag.

maria_support: Thanks — I'll tell ACME we're running an A/B and can offer a pinned route if needed. @sam_cse can you confirm preferred 2-hour window this afternoon PST?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: note — rolling-back hosted model requires a full-canary approval from SRE. I'll queue the approval once eng requests it.
